node.title: Re: use of already eval()ed module (from string)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
The typical solution would be to add fake entries to [doc://%INC], so [doc://require] and therefore [doc://use] thinks the module has already been loaded and doesn't need to be loaded again. If I put $INC{'Test/Module/Hello/Hello.pm'}=1; after the first [doc://eval] and $INC{'Test/Module/Hello/Goodbye.pm'}=1; after the second, your code seems to run fine, even when I reenable the use lines. (If later parts of your program might depend on it, you might want to add a more useful value to %INC instead of 1.)

An alternative (but equivalent) solution is to put [mod://me::inlined|use me::inlined;] in each of the packages you're evaling.
